overview: Copie Past-e is a SaaS web app for archiving, reusing, and posting marketplace listings, optimized for speed with a retro-futuristic dark UI. Users can import listings via Smart Photo OCR (Gemini), Smart Text Paste, or Manual Entry, and post to Facebook Marketplace via a Chrome extension.
features: Smart Photo OCR via Gemini (extension-based or canister-based fallback)
Chrome extension with Gemini API key storage and OCR intercept
Tiered subscriptions with Stripe payments on ICP
Admin panel with user management, analytics, backup/restore, and debugger
Mobile-responsive UI with retro-futuristic BTTF theme
